The total import duty for `manifests/ship-0412.csv` is **473.74**.

| Line | HS code | Description | Rate | Duty |

| 2 | 6403.99 | leather boots | 8.0% | 209.24 |
| 3 | 4202.92 | duffel bags | 3.5% | 32.55 |

`duty.py` gets the rate table from the `DUTYBOOK` environment variable, which the README doesn't mention. `schedules/hs-2026.csv` is the only schedule in the repo, so I used that one and didn't change `duty.py`:

```
DUTYBOOK=schedules/hs-2026.csv python3 duty.py manifests/ship-0412.csv
```

If you meant a different schedule, the total will change. I also saved a note to memory that `DUTYBOOK` has to be set for this script, so future sessions will know.
